I farm a small maize plot here in Mangochi, so I must keep my costs low and use what I can manage with my family. If I can get subsidized fertilizer and improved seed, I will use them, but not in a very high amount because my land is small and money is tight. I will also put some manure if I have it, and I do not plan to irrigate because I depend on the rains. I will not use pesticide or herbicide because for food crops here we rarely use them and they cost money.
